nexomod.settings.positionObscuring.title: Position Obscuring
nexomod.settings.obscure.preset.tooltip: None turns all position obscuring off, Full turns everything on, Custom uses the toggles below.
nexomod.settings.obscure.coords.tooltip: Shifts the X/Z coordinates on the F3 screen by a random 3k–700k blocks, re-rolled every time you join a world or server.
nexomod.settings.obscure.blockRotation.t: Random block textures (grass, stone, sand...) normally rotate based on your real position, which screenshots can be matched against. This re-seeds them from the fake coordinates so the pattern agrees with what F3 shows.
nexomod.settings.obscure.bedrockFloor.to: The bedrock pattern at the bottom of the world is generated from the world seed, so a screenshot of it can reveal your coordinates. This renders everything at Y -60 and below as solid bedrock (visual only — mining and collision are unaffected).
nexomod.coords.xaeroWarning: Nexo can't hide coordinates in Xaero's Minimap — it is showing your real position
nexomod.coords.f3warning: Coordinates are NOT obscured — press F3 again within 10 seconds to open anyway

nexomod.macros.name: Name
nexomod.macros.commandsLabel: Commands — sent in order. Start with / for a command, otherwise it's sent as chat. Placeholders: %myname%, %pos%, %x%, %y%, %z%, %clipboard%
nexomod.macros.field.posInt: Must be a positive whole number
